summary: All 8 plan phases completed and committed. Phase 1: reconciled draft-07 schema (errors-schema.json) plus prose format contract (errors-format.md), registered in index-entries.json. Phases 2-3: errors-append.sh with append (near-direct events-append.sh port) and update (original read-modify-write held under one flock, validating the merged document before the atomic mv) subcommands. Phase 4: 14-case regression suite (concurrency N=25, concurrent-update M=10, 9 rejection cases, lazy-creation, shape-conformance), verified to actually discriminate. Phase 5: deploy-path wiring in manifest.json and verify-deploy.sh (gate 1 now 9 entries). Phase 6: reconciled all three conflicting doc blocks in rules/error-handling.md and commands/errors.md; verified the Git Commit block byte-identical. Phase 7: converted the sole live inline jq writer in skill-planner/SKILL.md. Phase 8: bootstrapped specs/errors.json, regenerated the deploy tree, hit and repaired the known deploy-mechanism gap (broader than documented -- the Sync-all scan path never recurses into scripts/tests or scripts/lib at all), then verified end-to-end from the deployed path including both live readers.
decisions_made: Top level is object-with-array {"errors": [...]}, not a bare array: both live readers (orchestrator-postflight.sh, hooks/events-log-artifact.sh) already index .errors[] / .errors[-1], so this costs zero reader changes and admits a future schema_version key

errors-append.sh takes TWO subcommands (append, update); update is original read-modify-write design holding one flock across the whole read -> transform -> temp-write -> validate -> atomic-mv sequence, validating the MERGED document (not the delta) before the mv
Validation is hand-written bash checks kept in sync with the schema doc, matching the events-append.sh idiom; no ajv or python3 -m jsonschema dependency was introduced

fix_status enum is unfixed|in_progress|fixed|resolved, with resolved documented as a DEPRECATED synonym for fixed so already-written cross-repo data validates on read; the update subcommand REJECTS resolved as an input value so the deprecation cannot re-propagate
recurrence_count was dropped from the persisted schema; /errors' Analyze Patterns section now states recurrence is computed at query time by grouping on type

The verification bar's grep for inline '.errors +=' writers is satisfied as 'zero hits outside errors-append.sh', not literally zero hits repo-wide -- errors-append.sh's own internal jq expression is the sanctioned writer, not a rogue duplicate. This matches the plan's own Phase 7 goal text and the task's outer VERIFICATION BAR wording; the plan's individual verification bullets inherited the Overview's unqualified wording and were treated as a plan wording gap, not a defect

The known deploy-mechanism gap DID bite, and was broader than documented: the headless 'Sync all' scan path (sync.scan_all_artifacts) returns zero is_subdir=true entries for the scripts category -- it never recurses into scripts/tests/ or scripts/lib/, for either brand-new or already-deployed files. Repaired via the documented one-off loader-primitive workaround (direct headless-nvim invocation of loader.copy_scripts), never by hand-authoring the deployed file. The underlying Lua gap remains open as a follow-up, out of this task's scope
Added **/.errors.lock to .gitignore alongside the existing **/.events.lock entry -- an unplanned but necessary completeness fix so the ephemeral lock file does not accumulate as an untracked artifact
dead_ends: Do not treat the literal 'grep returns zero hits' verification bullets as requiring errors-append.sh's own internal .errors += expression to be eliminated -- that would mean the writer script cannot use jq to build its own merge, which is nonsensical. The correct bar is zero hits OUTSIDE errors-append.sh.

Do not assume deploy-headless.sh reliably picks up subdirectory scripts/ files (scripts/tests/*.sh, scripts/lib/*.sh) even after a second run -- confirmed non-idempotent-fixing for this specific gap. Always explicitly verify each of the four deploy artifacts individually rather than trusting the deploy tool's own summary count.

Do not hand-author .claude/scripts/tests/test-errors-append.sh to work around the gap -- it would be silently wiped by the next regeneration and create a false green. Use the loader-primitive workaround instead.
